title: Little Ming Forgets A Character
synopsis: Little Ming has trouble remembering how to write a certain Chinese character during an exam.

fullText.simplified:
小明考试

    语文考试上，有一题需要写“恩惠”两个字。小明想了很久，也没有想起“惠”字怎么写，他很着急。
    突然，他看见桌面上的矿泉水瓶。他经常买这种矿泉水，知道现在这种矿泉水有“买一送一”的活动。打开瓶盖，如果瓶盖里写着“再来一瓶”那就是中奖了，可以免费得一瓶矿泉水；如果瓶盖里写着“谢谢惠顾”那就是没有中奖。
    小明买了很多次矿泉水，都没有中奖。他想，这次瓶盖里肯定也会写着“谢谢惠顾”。这个“惠”和“恩惠”的“惠”一样。这样，他就可以知道“惠”字怎么写了。他觉得自己很聪明。
    于是，他悄悄拿起矿泉水，打开瓶盖，假装喝水，顺便看了一眼瓶盖，却傻了眼。原来，瓶盖上面写着：再来一瓶！
fullText.traditional:
小明考試

    語文考試上，有一題需要寫“恩惠”兩個字。小明想了很久，也沒有想起“惠”字怎麼寫，他很著急。
    突然，他看見桌面上的礦泉水瓶。他經常買這種礦泉水，知道現在這種礦泉水有“買一送一”的活動。打開瓶蓋，如果瓶蓋裡寫著“再來一瓶”那就是中獎了，可以免費得一瓶礦泉水；如果瓶蓋裡寫著“謝謝惠顧”那就是沒有中獎。
    小明買了很多次礦泉水，都沒有中獎。他想，這次瓶蓋裡肯定也會寫著“謝謝惠顧”。這個“惠”和“恩惠”的“惠”一樣。這樣，他就可以知道“惠”字怎麼寫了。他覺得自己很聰明。
    於是，他悄悄拿起礦泉水，打開瓶蓋，假裝喝水，順便看了一眼瓶蓋，卻傻了眼。原來，瓶蓋上面寫著：再來一瓶！

raw.synopsis: Little Ming has trouble remembering how to write a certain Chinese character during an exam.
sentence_translations: In the literature and language exam, there was a question where you had to write the two characters for “grace”.
Little Ming thought for a long time, but couldn’t remember how to write the “hui” character, and got stressed.
Suddenly, he noticed the mineral water bottle on top of the table.
He often bought this brand of mineral water and knew that they currently ran a “buy one get one free” campaign.
You open the lid and if the inside of the lid says “Have another bottle”, then you have won the prize.
You can then get another bottle of mineral water for free.
If the inside of the lid says “Thank you for your support”, then you did not win.
Little Ming had bought this mineral water many times before but never won.
He figured that the inside of the lid would certainly say “Thank you for your support” this time as well.
This “hui” character is the same as “hui” in “grace”.
This way, he would find out how to write the “hui” character.
He thought he was really clever.
And thus, he quietly grabbed the mineral water, opened the lid, and pretended to drink water.
He cast a glance at the lid and was dumbfounded.
It turned out that the text in the lid said: “Have another bottle!”
